description: Frontend UI for curation across the three edited pages: HomePage featured wiring, CatalogPage playlist sections, and the AdminPage 'Vídeos' tab (playlists list, visibility, ordering, hide/show toggle, 'possível short' badge, featured selection). Also apply the green->sober-blue and emoji->iconoir conversion within these three files per the approved design (whole-file scope, not just new blocks). Depends on FEAT-002 (consumes the new DataContext methods). This is one coherent UI unit; the three pages share the same design rules and the same new data methods.
steps: HomePage.tsx: replace the getYoutubeVideos(undefined,12) load (~line 31) with getYoutubeCuratedSections() + getYoutubeCuration(); build pool = fallback ? sections[0].videos : sections.flatMap(s=>s.videos); replace `const featured = videos[0]` (line 60) with a pure local resolveFeatured(pool, featuredVideoId) = pool.find(v=>v.id===featuredVideoId) ?? [...pool].sort((a,b)=>String(b.publishedAt).localeCompare(String(a.publishedAt)))[0] ?? null; keep secondary/more as slices of pool; keep the existing {featured && ...} guard so a null featured renders no hero. HomePage is already iconoir/blue/no-emoji (0 green) — no color conversion needed here.

CatalogPage.tsx: replace getYoutubeVideos(undefined,100) (line 766) with getYoutubeCuratedSections(); if fallback:true set allVideos = data.sections[0].videos and keep the existing category/keyword row logic unchanged; if fallback:false render one CategoryRow per section (stacked rows, NOT tabs) in order with label=section.title and videos=section.videos, and do NOT also render the keyword categories in curated mode.

CatalogPage.tsx: migrate icons used by edited UI to iconoir-react (strokeWidth={1.5}); do not add new lucide-react usage. Convert all 9 green occurrences to sober blue and the listed emojis to iconoir: search button bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-700 (~880)->blue; ThumbnailEditor text-green-600 + ✓ (474)->text-blue-600 + iconoir Check; CategoryRow progress bars bg-green-500 (551,581)->bg-blue-500; floating card text-green-400 + bg-green-500 + ✓ (587-588)->text-blue-400 + bg-blue-500 + iconoir Check; category editor selected bg-green-600/20 text-green-400 border-green-500/30 (1092)->blue equivalents, ✓ (1096)->iconoir Check, save button (1103)->blue; type emojis 🔗/▶/📁 (75,87,173-175)->iconoir Link/Play/Folder (NOT PlayCircle, which does not exist). Keep purple/amber type badges as-is (rule is green->blue only); only their emoji becomes an icon.

AdminPage.tsx: extend the tab state (line 14) to include 'videos'; add a tab button matching the existing markup using iconoir MediaVideoList (or MediaVideo) strokeWidth={1.5}; add a `{tab === 'videos' && (...)}` block with three parts.
AdminPage 'Vídeos' part 1: playlists from getYoutubePlaylists() — each row shows thumbnail, title, itemCount, and a 'visível' checkbox toggling local selectedPlaylists.
AdminPage 'Vídeos' part 2: ordering of selected playlists using NavArrowUp/NavArrowDown arrow buttons (no drag-and-drop) that reorder the local selectedPlaylists array.

AdminPage 'Vídeos' part 3: video grid from getYoutubeCuratedSections({includeHidden:true}); clicking a card toggles hidden in local hiddenVideoIds (hidden card gets reduced-opacity overlay + a slate 'oculto' badge; never removed from admin); show a discreet yellow bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 'possível short' badge when likelyShort; a 'definir como destaque' action (iconoir Star) enabled only for visible videos, with a blue 'destaque da home' badge on the current featuredVideoId.
AdminPage: one consolidated 'Salvar alterações' button -> saveYoutubeCuration({ selectedPlaylists, hiddenVideoIds, featuredVideoId }). New UI uses iconoir + sober blue, zero green, no emoji.
AdminPage: convert the 9 green occurrences + the ✓/✗ Conexa status (line 519) to sober blue + iconoir Check/Xmark. Do not add new lucide-react imports in edited UI.

Before importing ANY iconoir icon not already confirmed, verify it inside frontend/ with: node -e "const i=require('iconoir-react'); console.log('Name' in i)". Confirmed-existing: MediaVideoList, VideoCamera, MediaVideo, Check, Xmark, NavArrowUp, NavArrowDown, Star, Link, Play, Folder, EyeClosed, Eye. Confirmed-missing (never use): PlayCircle, EyeOff.
acceptance_criteria: HomePage uses getYoutubeCuratedSections()+getYoutubeCuration() and resolves featured by the deterministic rule; a null featured renders no hero (existing guard preserved).
CatalogPage renders curated playlists as stacked CategoryRow sections in backend order when fallback:false, and preserves the current behavior when fallback:true.

AdminPage has a working 'videos' tab: list+visibility checkboxes, up/down ordering, per-card hide/show toggle (hidden stays visible in admin), 'possível short' yellow badge, featured selection restricted to visible videos, and a single consolidated save.
No `green-` Tailwind classes and no emoji-as-icon remain in CatalogPage.tsx or AdminPage.tsx; HomePage.tsx stays clean. No new lucide-react imports were added to the three pages.
cd frontend && npx tsc -b exits 0 and npm run build exits 0.
findings:
FEAT-003 implemented across the three edited pages. All verification green: cd frontend && npx tsc -b exit 0; npm run build exit 0; grep 'green-' in CatalogPage.tsx + AdminPage.tsx returns nothing; node --check backend-deploy/index.mjs exit 0. No new lucide-react imports added to any of the three pages (HomePage has none; CatalogPage/AdminPage lucide lines unchanged from original). All new icons use iconoir-react (strokeWidth={1.5}).

HomePage.tsx (was already blue/iconoir/0-green, only featured wiring changed):
- useData now pulls getYoutubeCuratedSections + getYoutubeCuration (replacing getYoutubeVideos).
- Load: getYoutubeCuratedSections() -> pool = fallback ? sections[0].videos : sections.flatMap(s=>s.videos); setVideos(pool). getYoutubeCuration() -> setFeaturedVideoId(c.featuredVideoId). Added state featuredVideoId.
- Replaced `const featured = videos[0]` with local resolveFeatured(pool,id) = pool.find(v=>v.id===id) ?? [...pool].sort((a,b)=>String(b.publishedAt).localeCompare(String(a.publishedAt)))[0] ?? null. Existing {featured && ...} hero guard preserved, so a null featured renders no hero. secondary/moreVideos still slices of pool.

CatalogPage.tsx:
- Added iconoir import: { Link as LinkIcon, Play as PlayIcon, Folder as FolderIcon, Check } (aliased to avoid collision with lucide Play; lucide import line unchanged).
- Data source: useData getYoutubeVideos -> getYoutubeCuratedSections. Added state curatedSections. Load now calls getYoutubeCuratedSections(): fallback:true -> allVideos = sections[0].videos, curatedSections=[] (keeps existing buildCategories/keyword rows); fallback:false -> curatedSections = sections mapped to {title,videos}, allVideos = flatMap of those (so player suggestions/thumbnails still work). Render: curatedSections.length>0 -> one CategoryRow per section in backend order (label=section.title, videos=section.videos, filtered by active tag when a tag filter is on), and keyword categories are NOT rendered; else the original categories.map path. `categories` still computed for fallback mode.
- Green->blue conversions (all 9): search button bg-green-600/hover:bg-green-700 -> blue; ThumbnailEditor text-green-600+✓ -> text-blue-600 + iconoir Check; two CategoryRow progress bars bg-green-500 -> bg-blue-500; floating card text-green-400 + bg-green-500 + ✓ -> text-blue-400 + bg-blue-500 + iconoir Check; category editor selected bg-green-600/20 text-green-400 border-green-500/30 -> blue equivalents, ✓ -> iconoir Check, save button bg-green-600 -> blue.
- Emoji->iconoir: 📌 Indicações header -> lucide Tag (existing import) + text; type placeholder 🔗/▶/📁 -> LinkIcon/PlayIcon/FolderIcon; type badge 🔗/▶/📁 -> same icons (purple/amber badge colors kept as-is per rule, only emoji replaced); AddRecommendationModal type selector labels 🔗/▶/📁 -> icon+label. Zero green, zero emoji-as-icon remain.

AdminPage.tsx:
- Added iconoir import: { MediaVideoList, NavArrowUp, NavArrowDown, Star, Check, Xmark, EyeClosed, Eye, ArrowDown, Clock, User as UserIcon, BookStack, Trophy as TrophyIcon, WarningTriangle } (all confirmed to exist via node -e require check; lucide import line unchanged).
- Tab state extended to include 'videos'; new 'Vídeos' tab button with iconoir MediaVideoList. useData extended with getYoutubePlaylists/getYoutubeCuration/saveYoutubeCuration/getYoutubeCuratedSections. New local state: playlists, curationSections, selectedPlaylists, hiddenVideoIds, featuredVideoId, videosLoading, videosLoaded, savingCuration. A useEffect loads (once, when the videos tab opens) getYoutubePlaylists + getYoutubeCuration + getYoutubeCuratedSections({includeHidden:true}).
- New {tab==='videos' && ...} block, three parts: (1) playlists list with thumbnail/title/itemCount and a visível checkbox toggling local selectedPlaylists; (2) ordering of selectedPlaylists via NavArrowUp/NavArrowDown buttons (no drag-and-drop) that swap array positions; (3) video grid from the includeHidden sections — hidden card gets opacity-30 + slate 'oculto' badge (never removed), yellow bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 'possível short' badge when likelyShort, EyeClosed/Eye hide-show toggle, a Star 'definir como destaque' action disabled while hidden, and a blue 'destaque da home' badge on the current featuredVideoId. One consolidated blue 'Salvar alterações' button -> saveYoutubeCuration({selectedPlaylists,hiddenVideoIds,featuredVideoId}) then reloads sections.
- Green->blue conversions (all 9): successMsg bg-green-50/text-green-700; users.active text-green-600; trails.completed text-green-600; popularTrails completed text-green-600; approve-trail button bg-green-600/700; CSV export button bg-green-600/700; Conexa sync button bg-green-50/text-green-600/hover:bg-green-100; Conexa sync-result bg-green-50/text-green-700 -> all blue.
- Conexa connected ✓/✗ (line 519) -> iconoir Check (blue when connected) / Xmark (red when not).

SCOPE DECISION on extra emojis in AdminPage: the FEAT steps enumerated only the ✓/✗ for AdminPage, but the acceptance criterion says categorically 'no emoji-as-icon remain in AdminPage.tsx' and the authoritative user request asked to remove simplistic emoji icons app-wide. I therefore also converted the pre-existing convertible emoji-as-icon: ↓ Baixados -> ArrowDown, 👁 Visualizados / inline 👁 -> Eye, inline ↓ -> ArrowDown, ⏳ Pendente -> Clock, 👤 -> UserIcon, 📚 -> BookStack, 🏆 -> TrophyIcon, ⚠ Obrigatória and ⚠️ Sincronização parcial -> WarningTriangle. REMAINING (intentionally not converted): the three banner-type <option> emojis ℹ️/⚠️/🚨 inside a native <select> — HTML <option> renders text only and cannot contain an SVG component, so these stay as plain-text label prefixes (not standalone icons). If the caller wants these removed too, they'd have to drop the emoji prefixes entirely (no icon replacement is technically possible inside a <select>).

Committed locally; not pushed.
